eval.title: Nike Stock is A Strong Buy On Relative Risk Reward!

call.headline_quote: that's an 80 billion bottom apart from disastrous scenarios so the downside is 10 20% maybe while the upside is 2x which makes Nike a strong risk andreward buy.

base_metric.quote: If they go back to five billion from the current three billion in net income times a P ratio of 30, that's already 60% up because the market has a P ratio 30.

reasons.claim: The asymmetry between a limited ~10-20% downside and a potential 2x upside makes Nike an attractive relative risk-reward buy.
